name: VHCB conservation grants (natural areas, local conservation and working forestlands)
summary: Vermont state grants to land trusts, municipalities and agencies to conserve natural areas with rare-species habitat, working forestland and locally significant natural and recreational land. Local grants cover acquisition and associated costs and need a one-third match.

amount.note: Local Conservation Grant Program, for recreational lands and natural areas, plus associated costs

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are nonprofit housing and conservation organizations with federal 501(c)(3) status, Vermont municipalities, and certain state agencies.

geography.quote: VHCB funding is available for the conservation of Vermont forests owned and managed by private individuals or families.

access.quote: Eligible applicants are asked to call VHCB staff to discuss your project prior to completing an application.

amount.quote: grants of up to $150,000 plus associated costs are available for the purchase of recreational lands and natural areas
